scenarios.purpose: All three preparation interfaces save WIP locally without remote writes
Clean profile reconstructs shared content/order with no local manifest
Failed comment page is partial rather than empty/deleted
New machine sees only available pending bytes and no grant/private WIP
CLI uses the running desktop owner rather than a second writer
Commit-before-disconnect is reconciled by request identity
Dirty IME and external-editor revision conflicts preserve text
Shared undo/redo retains raw bytes and never invokes model/GitHub
Explicit draft identity isolates concurrent skill callers
Manual terminal flow works with no GUI/model
Standalone tests-disabled binary has no GUI/display dependencies
Untrusted control sequences do not execute in terminal
Ready or JSON is not a publication grant
Reconciliation prevents duplicate creations after unknown outcome
Changing and undoing identical prose invalidates old ticket
Skeleton cannot contain hidden publishable comments or ready flags
Machine fetch is not an author visit
Effective hooks use active model without nested launch
Claimed provider cannot bypass required verified context policy
Attended run uses installed skill with actual binary and permissions
